items.title: Kathmandu to face Chitwan in NPL Eliminator after loss to Pokhara
items.blurb: Kathmandu finish third with a 55-run defeat, while Kushal Bhurtel misses a century by one run as Pokhara post a record 224.

items.title: Karnali sign off with consolation win as Chitwan finish fourth
items.blurb: The Rhinos, already through to the playoffs, end the league stage on seven points after falling 24 runs short of a 154-run target.

items.title: Bhattarai urges Prime Minister Shah to put five issues on agenda for India visit
items.blurb: In an interview with Kantipur, the former prime minister says Nepal should press India on the border dispute, trade deficit, air routes and hydropower, while seeking trilateral cooperation on the Himalayan climate…

items.title: Hydropower firms to need 50 percent construction progress for IPOs
items.blurb: The proposed ordinance would allow companies to issue shares before commercial production begins, provided their projects have completed at least half of the physical work.

items.title: Karnali set Chitwan a target of 154 in final league match
items.blurb: Hasan Talat hits an unbeaten half-century as Karnali Yakss, already out of playoff contention, post 153-8; Chitwan have secured a playoff berth.

items.title: And then there were four: Lumbini lead NPL playoff pack
items.blurb: The defending champions sealed the top spot with a four-wicket win over Biratnagar, leaving Sudurpaschim, Kathmandu and Chitwan to fight over second to fourth on Sunday.

items.title: Who is the real prime minister?
items.blurb: After the IGP removal and journalist detentions, Lamichhane’s claim of a right to intervene has reopened a question the RSP’s landslide was meant to settle.
